description: Two large, organic yellow and orange forms rise from the bottom of the composition. The forms stand against a bright blue background with a few soft, white forms floating atop it. The semiabstract composition resembles two trees with yellow and orange leaves standing against a blue sky with white clouds.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
